description: Approved NemoClaw operation and configuration observations with public categories, host fields, approximate location, and field status. Production approval remains separate.

gdpr.description: Measure completed operations with approved public dimensions and no entity identifiers or user content. Consent and collection approval remain required.

nemoclaw_install_completed.description: A NemoClaw install or update completed successfully; configuration is not inferred from unrelated state.

gdpr.description: Measure approved committed configuration and approximate location without entity identifiers, private values, or user content. Activation remains separate.

nemoclaw_configuration_completed.description: One committed primary or published configuration observation, not an install count or unique environment.

gdpr.description: Count published environment registrations without identifiers. Activation remains separate.

nemoclaw_sandbox_count_observed.description: The published environment count in one complete snapshot; zero is valid.

gdpr.description: Count recorded configured agent runtime categories without identifiers. Activation remains separate.

nemoclaw_agent_runtime_observed.description: A nonzero count of recorded configured agents using one approved runtime category.

gdpr.description: Count approved managed-agent version categories without raw custom versions. Activation remains separate.

nemoclaw_managed_agent_version_observed.description: A nonzero managed-agent version count from valid product-owned workload provenance.

gdpr.description: Count recorded agent-route assignments using approved public model, provider, API, and selection categories. Activation remains separate.

nemoclaw_model_observed.description: A nonzero recorded primary-route assignment count, not inference activity or a unique route count.

gdpr.description: Count configured messaging categories without credentials, identities, or messages. Activation remains separate.

nemoclaw_messaging_observed.description: A nonzero count of published environments with one configured channel category, deduplicated per environment.

gdpr.description: Measure closed host-platform and recorded sandbox-configuration categories without private inventory. Activation remains separate.

nemoclaw_configuration_observed.description: One host-platform observation or a nonzero sandbox-signal count from a complete snapshot.
